entities.summary: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sabāʾ al-Ḥimyarī, sometimes also called Ibn Sabāʾ, Ibn al-Sawdāʾ, or Ibn Wahb, was a 7th-century figure in Islamic history associated with a group of followers called the Sabaʾiyya (سبئية). Abd Allah ibn Saba' was a theologians & scholars from Yemen. Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
